Resolves #21797

🌿 A zoom's old scroll position can no longer pass for its new one.

The zoom-anchor spec's `zoom()` counted a reading as settled once two reads agreed and the App Worker had seen the DOM's scroll position, and before a zoom's scroll lands the old position passes both. A region that was scrolled now also has to leave its old position when the scale changes; a zoom from position 0 keeps the old check. Spec-only; the zoom (#21693) is right.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e with the CPU throttled 12×, red on base and green at the head) → L3 required (a main-thread timing race seen in hosted CI). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: zero-delta — one spec helper's wait condition.
